content: MS Majlis 10196 ff. 148b-53b carries Żawʾ al-Lamaʿāt (variant Sharḥ-i Lamaʿāt), copied on 8 Dhū l-Qaʿda 828/21 September 1425 (Ḥāʾirī, Majlis, 32/238); the entry prints the CE date twice. The earliest of the other copies is MS Ankara Adnan Ötüken 15/4 pp. 59-72, copied by ʿAbd al-Malik b. Badr al-Balkhī in 833/1429.
